verdict.rationale: Gusto documents explicit API versioning (X-Gusto-API-Version header, per-version Postman collections, version-gated error formats since 2023-02-01), showing a real versioning scheme. However, the evidence pack contains no explicit deprecation policy (e.g., sunset timelines, notice periods, migration guides between versions). Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, migration guidance between API versions, and independent confirmation of how version transitions are handled in practice.
